name: deep-research-skills
description: True deep research skills that go beyond surface search: extensive multi-database literature investigation, cross-domain dot-connection, source-provenance control, evidence appraisal, and citation verification. Covers published medical literature (medical-research-detective), auditing video claims against the primary sources they cite with A+ to F grading (video-source-audit), and interpreting personal genome raw data against the literature with absolute-risk framing and hard clinical-confirmation rails (dna-raw-data-audit).
